title: Maternity Photoshoot in Delhi: Timing, Price & Studio Checklist

children.text: When to schedule a maternity photoshoot in Delhi, what packages typically cost, what to wear, and how to pick a studio and plan a session that stays comfortable from start to finish.

layout.content: Maternity Photoshoot in Delhi: Timing, Price & Studio Checklist

A maternity photoshoot in Delhi is easy to book and surprisingly easy to get wrong. Book too late and you are tired, swollen and fitting the shoot around hospital appointments; pick the wrong space and you spend two hours climbing stairs, changing in a corner and sweating under hot lights. This guide covers the weeks most photographers recommend, what packages typically cost in Delhi NCR, what to wear, a comfort-first checklist for choosing a studio, and a session plan with breaks built in. It is written for expecting parents and for the freelance photographers who rent studios to shoot them.
Best time for a maternity photoshoot: which month and which week

Most Indian maternity photographers recommend shooting between roughly weeks 28 and 35, which is the 7th to early 8th month. By then the bump is clearly visible and rounded, but most people still have the energy to stand, sit and change outfits for a couple of hours.

items: Single pregnancy: aim for weeks 28 to 35
Twins: many photographers suggest shooting earlier, around the 5th or 6th month, because the bump grows faster and comfort drops sooner
Baby-shower invitations: shoot around weeks 27 to 28 so photos are edited in time to print or share
High-risk pregnancy or any complications: check with your doctor before you book, and choose a flexible date

layout.content: Rule of thumb: book the date for around week 30, then keep a backup date a week earlier in case you need it.

Can you shoot at 36 weeks or later? Many people do, especially for a final-month or godh bharai shoot, but keep it shorter, choose a studio close to home, and clear it with your doctor first. Godh bharai and seemantham shoots are often scheduled around the 7th or 9th month, depending on family tradition.
Maternity shoot price in Delhi
Prices depend on hours, outfit changes, the number of edited images, whether hair and makeup are included, and whether the studio hire is part of the package. Indicatively:

items: Packages we have seen listed by Delhi photographers run roughly from ₹5,000 to ₹30,000
Premium packages with styling, multiple sets and albums can go above ₹1 lakh
Maternity gowns on rent in Delhi are listed from roughly ₹1,900 to ₹4,000 per gown
Many packages include two to three outfit changes

layout.content: When comparing quotes, ask each photographer for the same details: total hours, number of outfits, number of edited images, delivery time, and whether studio rent, gowns and makeup are included or extra. If you are a photographer quoting a client, price the studio hours separately so the client sees exactly what they are paying for.
Studio or outdoor: why many Delhi families choose a studio

Outdoor shoots in Lodhi Garden or Sunder Nursery look lovely in photos, but they come with heat, crowds, traffic and, from late October, Delhi's frequently poor air quality. A studio trades some of that scenery for things that matter more in the third trimester:

items: Privacy for bump-reveal and fabric-draped shots
Climate control: AC in summer, a heater in winter
A place to sit or lie down between setups
A proper changing room for outfit changes
A washroom a few steps away

layout.content: Maternity shoot ideas indoor are not limited to a white wall either. A good studio can give you a soft-light window set, a dark dramatic backdrop for silhouettes, a floral arch, a bed or couch set for couple shots, and a plain cyc for flowing gown shots, all in one booking.
Comfort-first studio checklist
Before you book, message the host and confirm each of these. A listing's photos rarely show all of them.

items: Washroom on the same floor, ideally inside the studio
Lift access or no more than a few stairs
Comfortable seating: a sofa, a chair with back support, or a bed set
Working AC and, in winter, a heater
A private changing room with a mirror and hooks for gowns
Space to keep water, juice and light snacks
A quiet corner to rest between setups
Parking close to the entrance
Permission for extra guests if your partner, older child or parents are joining
Pet policy, if you want your dog in a few frames

layout.content: For photographers renting the studio: book 30 minutes longer than the client's package so lighting changes and breaks do not eat into shooting time.
A 2 to 3 hour session plan with breaks
A comfortable maternity session rarely needs more than three hours. Here is a plan for a 2.5-hour studio slot with three outfits:

items: 0:00 to 0:20: arrive, settle in, water, first outfit and makeup touch-up while lights are set
0:20 to 0:50: Outfit 1, the saree look, on a soft-light set; standing and seated poses
0:50 to 1:05: break, snacks, feet up
1:05 to 1:35: Outfit 2, the flowing gown, on a plain backdrop; fabric toss and silhouette shots
1:35 to 1:50: break and change
1:50 to 2:20: Outfit 3, the couple or family look; partner, older child, pet
2:20 to 2:30: final details, belly and hands close-ups, pack up

layout.content: Comfortable posing matters more than dramatic posing. Good poses for the third trimester include sitting on a stool with one leg extended, standing with weight on the back foot and a hand under the bump, lying on the side with pillows, and seated couple poses where the partner supports from behind. Experienced maternity photographers tend to skip deep squats and long holds in awkward positions, and keep every pose short. If something feels uncomfortable, stop; a good photographer will never push, and your doctor's advice always comes first.
What to wear and what to bring

The most common outfit mix in Delhi maternity shoots is a saree look, a flowing gown and a coordinated couple or family look. Choose fabrics that drape well, such as chiffon, georgette and soft cotton, and avoid anything tight around the bump unless it is meant to show the silhouette.

items: Two to three outfits, steamed and on hangers
Comfortable flats or slippers for between shots
Nude and black undergarments, including a supportive bra
Water bottle, coconut water and light snacks
Any medication you need and your doctor's number
Small props: ultrasound print, baby shoes, letter boards, flowers
Partner's outfits in a colour that matches yours
A cardigan or shawl, since studio AC can feel cold between setups

layout.content: Including your partner, older children or pets? Schedule them in the last outfit slot so they are not waiting for two hours, and bring a snack or toy for the child.
FAQs: Maternity photoshoot in Delhi
Which month is best for a maternity photoshoot?

The 7th to early 8th month, roughly weeks 28 to 35, is the window most photographers recommend. For twins, many suggest the 5th or 6th month. If your pregnancy is high-risk, check with your doctor first.
How much does a maternity shoot cost in Delhi?

Packages we have seen listed by Delhi photographers commonly fall between about ₹5,000 and ₹30,000, with premium packages above ₹1 lakh. Check what is included: hours, outfits, edited images, studio rent and makeup.
What should I wear for a maternity photoshoot?
A mix of a saree, a flowing gown and a coordinated couple or family look works well. Gowns on rent in Delhi are listed from roughly ₹1,900 to ₹4,000.
Can you do a maternity shoot at 36 weeks?
Many people do, but keep the session short, choose a studio near home with easy access, and get your doctor's go-ahead first.
Is a studio or outdoor maternity shoot better?
A studio offers privacy, climate control, a washroom and a place to rest, which makes it the more comfortable choice late in pregnancy and in Delhi's peak heat or poor-air months.

Final takeaways
A good maternity shoot is a comfortable one. Book for around week 30, choose a studio that puts your comfort first, and plan a session with breaks rather than squeezing in every pose.
